evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Rather than keeping every insertion, CARVE tests a candidate expanded canvas and asks a counterfactual question: would the model make similar predictions for the unresolved positions in the original canvas if the extra masked space were present?

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Crucially, CARVE achieves these accuracy gains while reducing inference cost, reaching half the FLOPs of fixed-length decoding in some settings.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across code generation and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CARVE consistently improves average performance over fixed-length baselines across all evaluated model families.
